fact: Launch Base Africa reports that the FindMe-Campost agreement signed in 2024 laid the groundwork for a country-wide Plan de Localisation Postal to standardize addressing in line with international postal standards.

Launch Base Africa reports that around 15,000 Cameroonians have generated geolocated addresses on FindMe's platform since the 2024 Campost agreement, certified through national postal partnerships for 2,000 CFA francs.
Business in Cameroon reports Campost signed a partnership with FindMe on 1 November 2024 in Yaounde to enhance the national address system.
source_slug: 2024-11-04 Cameroon's Campost partners with FindMe to improve national address system

fact: Business in Cameroon reports FindMe's postal-addressing model, already deployed in Senegal, has been operational in Cameroon since July 2024.
source_slug: 2024-11-04 Cameroon's Campost partners with FindMe to improve national address system

fact: Ecomatin reports that the Plan de Localisation Postale, produced by Campost and operated by the startup FindMe through its FindMe.House app, provides certified addresses linked to GPS maps, has been deployed for nearly two years, and stands at about 15,000 addresses against a target of 100,000 by end-2025.
